plaatsen.tekst: A devout man, and one that feared God with all his house, which gave much alms to the people, and prayed to God alway.
And when the angel which spake unto Cornelius was departed, he called two of his household servants, and a devout soldier of them that waited on him continually;
And one Ananias, a devout man according to the law, having a good report of all the Jews which dwelt
